Translation.Editor Export Help: Rerender the saved project with current clips, narration and captions. No new AI video generation is requested.
Translation.Editor Legacy Layout Help: Timeline shows the saved scene layout. Use the clip inspector to adjust duration for this older project.
Translation.Editor Play Failed: Use the video player controls to start playback.
Translation.Editor Preview Missing: No exported preview yet. Select a saved clip, or finish the task and export.
Translation.Editor Processing: Applying changes… Your saved clips are retained.
Translation.Editor Timeline Hint: Select a clip or cue to edit · Drag clips to reorder · Drag caption edges to adjust timing
Translation.Caption Draft Required: Prepare a caption draft first. Refresh it after narration sources change.
Translation.Caption Preview Help: Draft preview with narration and saved caption styling. Background music is omitted from this preview; exports retain the saved music.
Translation.Empty Caption Track: This draft has no cues. Applying it exports without captions.
Translation.Independent Caption Help: Edit caption text and timing independently of narration. Cues use seconds, must be ordered and cannot overlap. Prepare a draft, edit and preview it, then Apply to export. Restore returns to the current original or narration-generated captions. Creative AI tasks only.
Translation.Automatic Clip Duration Help: The existing Scene Director chooses AI scene lengths from the script and measured narration, within the model limit. Each scene can have a different length. Playback stays at normal speed. Matching is estimated, not verified speech alignment. Select a number for a manual maximum.
Translation.YouTube Audience Help: Choose based on the video's intended audience. This declaration is sent with YouTube uploads; it does not change the generated content.
Translation.Kokoro Voices Unavailable: Could not load Kokoro voices. Your previous selection is retained. Check the connection or enter voices manually.
Translation.Please enter your username and password: Please enter your username and password
Translation.Video Subject Help: AI will generate the video script from this topic.
Translation.Video Subject Placeholder: Example: How AI is changing everyday life
Translation.Factual Sources Help: One source per line: HTTPS URL | title | supporting excerpt (20–2000 characters). Add 1–6 sources. You may import an editable excerpt with the button above. The model checks the excerpts you accept before audio or video work; task generation does not fetch pages.
Translation.Factual Sources Invalid: Add 1–6 distinct sources, one per line: HTTPS URL | title | supporting excerpt (at least 20 characters).
Translation.Source Page Import Help: Fetch one public HTTPS page when you click Import. Check and edit the suggested excerpt below before generating. Redirects and private network addresses are refused.
Translation.Source Page Import Failed: Could not import this source page
Translation.Review Imported Excerpt: Review and edit the imported excerpt before generating. The model will check claims against the text you accept here.
Translation.Custom Script Requirements Placeholder: Example: use a lighter tone, fit TikTok style, target young viewers, make the opening more suspenseful
Translation.LoomLoom Batch Script Generation Help: LoomLoom generates multiple independent script candidates. Get a quote first; execution and billing start only after confirmation.
Translation.Shengsuan Cloud API Key Help: Create an API Key in the [Shengsuan Cloud console](https://console.shengsuanyun.com/user/keys). The key is saved to config.toml, and usage is billed to your account.
Translation.Shengsuan Cloud API Key Link: [Get an API Key from the Shengsuan Cloud console](https://console.shengsuanyun.com/user/keys)
Translation.Shengsuan Cloud API Key Required: Configure your Shengsuan Cloud API Key in Settings before using Shengsuan Cloud script or AI video generation.
Translation.Shengsuan Cloud API Key Reused: The Shengsuan Cloud API Key from Settings is reused here; no duplicate entry is needed.
Translation.Script Generation Method Help: Generate the script with the current LLM Provider configured in Settings.
Translation.LoomLoom Quote Summary: This run will generate {tasks} candidates for an estimated {amount} {currency}.
Translation.LoomLoom Quote Summary Singular: This run will generate 1 candidate for an estimated {amount} {currency}.
Translation.LoomLoom Quote Changed Warning: The subject or generation settings changed. Get a new quote before running.
Translation.Confirm LoomLoom Charge: I confirm this quote and authorize charging the current user's balance
Translation.Video Script Help: Leave blank to generate it with AI from the video subject. Proper punctuation helps generate subtitles. Supported on Azure TTS V1 (Edge TTS): use [pause: 2s] or [silence: 1s] to insert custom pauses (0.1–10s).
Translation.Please Enter the Video Subject: Please Enter the Video Script First
Translation.Please Enter the Video Subject First: Please enter the video subject first
Translation.No Tasks Match Filter: No tasks match the selected filter
Translation.Artifact Package Help: Portable task-relative paths for the final videos, script, captions, audio, scene plan, generation manifest, and active generated scenes.
Translation.Review Script Only Help: Run the factual script and evidence review without narration, video generation, or GPU use. Inspect the result in Task Manager before generating a video.
Translation.Factual Review Only Help: This task stopped after script review. Load its settings with Regenerate in Task Manager to start a new full video task; the new task will review the script again.
Translation.Factual Review Unavailable: The saved factual review could not be displayed.
Translation.Factual Review Limitation: This review checks supplied excerpts. It does not verify the source pages or their authenticity.
Translation.Narration Reviewed By You: Reviewed by you. This is not automated speech alignment.
Translation.Narration Ranges Help: Save estimated narration ranges and previews from the existing audio. These ranges use scene weights, not verified speech alignment. Visual reordering and screen-duration edits do not move them. Prepare again after changing the audio or narration text. No new speech is generated.
Translation.Scene Timing Help: Change a visual cut by setting this scene’s screen duration. The following scene balances the difference. Narration, captions and total duration stay fixed. Normal playback speed and enough saved footage are required. Moving a cut can change which words the footage accompanies.
Translation.Scene Reorder Help: Moving a scene changes visual playback order only. Narration and captions stay fixed, so the footage may accompany different words. Each clip keeps its current duration and version.
Translation.Uploaded Clip Active: This scene uses your uploaded clip. Prompt and seed controls still create a new AI version.
Translation.Clip Trim Help: Start within the saved clip or a new upload. Scene duration, narration and captions stay fixed. Enough footage must remain. Earlier versions remain available to restore. Older uploads kept only their normalized footage.
Translation.Trimmed Clip Active: This scene uses a saved trim. Narration and captions are unchanged.
Translation.Replacement Clip Help: Use a clip with the same aspect ratio that covers this scene's duration. Clips are trimmed from the selected start time. Clip audio is removed. Narration and captions stay unchanged. Maximum 100 MiB.
Translation.Regenerate Scene Help: Regenerate using the prompt and exact seed shown above.
Translation.New Variation Help: Regenerate this scene with the shown prompt and the next seed.
Translation.Restore Scene Version Help: Make the selected previous clip active again and rerender the final video without new AI inference.
Translation.Legacy Scene Version Help: This older clip predates per-version prompt/seed metadata, so it can be previewed but not safely restored.
Translation.No Scene Plan: No scene plan is available for this task
Translation.Cancellation Unavailable: This task can no longer be cancelled
Translation.Generating Video Script and Keywords: AI is generating video script and keywords...
Translation.Video Keywords Help: Leave blank to generate them with AI from the video script. Separate multiple keywords with English commas.
Translation.Video Fit Mode Help: Fill uses the entire output canvas and crops excess edges. Fit preserves the complete source frame and adds black bars when needed.
Translation.Clip Duration Help: Controls the duration of each clip used in the composition, not the total video length.
Translation.Clip Speed Help: Adjusts visual material playback only. Voiceover, subtitles, and the maximum output duration of each clip are unchanged.
Translation.Match Materials to Script Order Help: Generate keywords and match materials in script order so visuals follow the current voiceover.
Translation.Voiceover Volume Help: Adjusts automatic or uploaded voiceover volume. 100% keeps the original level.
Translation.Voiceover Speed Help: Applies only to automatic voiceover. 1.0× is the normal speed.
Translation.VoxCPM Speed Not Supported: VoxCPM does not support numeric speed adjustment.
Translation.Upload Voiceover File Help: The uploaded audio is used directly instead of generating a voiceover.
Translation.Please Upload Voiceover File First: Please upload a voiceover file first
Translation.Custom audio will be used directly. TTS: Custom audio will be used directly. TTS synthesis will be skipped for this task.
Translation.Background Music Preview Failed: Unable to preview this background music.
Translation.Selected Background Music Unavailable: The selected background music is unavailable. The first available song has been selected.
Translation.Sonilo Music Prompt Help: Optional style or mood guidance, up to 2000 characters. Leave empty to let Sonilo match the video automatically.
Translation.Sonilo Multiple Videos Warning: Sonilo generates music separately for each output video, so multiple videos consume multiple generations.
Translation.Sonilo API Key Required: Enter a Sonilo API Key to use Sonilo background music.
Translation.Sonilo BGM Fallback Warning: Video {index} was generated without Sonilo background music because the music request failed.
Translation.Batch Material Reuse Warning: Video {index} reused {count} source clips from earlier videos because the available candidates could not fill this video without reuse under the current ordering and duration settings.
Translation.ElevenLabs API Key Help: This key is shared with ElevenLabs TTS. It is masked and saved in your local config.toml.
Translation.ElevenLabs Music Prompt Help: Optional style or mood guidance, up to 1000 characters. Leave empty to let ElevenLabs match the video automatically.
Translation.ElevenLabs Multiple Videos Warning: ElevenLabs generates music separately for each output video, so multiple videos consume multiple generations.
Translation.ElevenLabs API Key Required: Enter an ElevenLabs API Key to use ElevenLabs background music.
Translation.ElevenLabs Connection Test Succeeded: ElevenLabs account and plan check passed. Music API access will be confirmed during generation.
Translation.ElevenLabs Paid Plan Required: The API Key is valid, but the ElevenLabs Music API requires a paid plan. Upgrade the account before generating music.
Translation.ElevenLabs BGM Fallback Warning: Video {index} was generated without ElevenLabs background music because the music request failed.
Translation.Custom Background Music File: Or Enter a Custom Music Path
Translation.Upload Background Music Help: Upload an MP3, M4A, AAC, WAV, FLAC, OGG, OPUS, or WMA file up to 30 MB. It will be stored persistently when video generation starts.
Translation.Invalid Background Music: Please upload a valid supported background music file up to 30 MB.
Translation.Background Music Validation Failed: Background music could not be validated because FFmpeg or storage is unavailable. Please check the server logs.
Translation.Word-by-word Timing Help: Word-by-word timing is most accurate with Azure TTS V1 (Edge TTS) or Whisper. Other voice providers may fall back to phrase or sentence timing.
Translation.Please enter a value between 0 and 100: Please enter a value between 0 and 100
Translation.Rounded Subtitle Background Help: Disabled by default. When enabled, subtitle backgrounds use a rounded translucent style that better fits the text width.
Translation.Subtitle Colors Are Indistinguishable: Subtitle text and background use the same color, so subtitles may not be visible.
Translation.Subtitle Font Does Not Support Text: The selected subtitle font does not support some script characters, so subtitles may be missing.
Translation.Rerender Existing AI Scenes Help: Rebuild this task's final MP4 from its stored AI scene clips. Render-only settings may change; AI-video and narration inputs cannot.
Translation.Video Script and Subject Cannot Both Be: Video Subject and Video Script cannot both be empty
Translation.You can download the generated video fro: You can download the generated video from the following links
Translation.Pixabay API Key: Pixabay API Key ([Get API Key](https://pixabay.com/api/docs/#api_search_videos)) :green[Free] · Fallback option
Translation.llm_provider_tips.fluxionai:
##### Fluxion AI Configuration
- **API Key**: Sign up through the [referral link]({api_key_url}) and create a key for an **OpenAI API group** in the console
- **Base Url**: Defaults to `{default_base_url}`. If your group uses another endpoint, enter its OpenAI-compatible API base URL (including `/v1`), not the full `/chat/completions` path
- **Model Name**: Defaults to `{default_model}`. Available models depend on your group; check the [model plaza]({model_docs_url})

Used to generate video scripts and stock-footage search terms. Native Anthropic and Gemini API groups are not supported by this entry.
Translation.llm_provider_tips.cheaperinference:
##### Cheaper Inference Configuration
- **API Key**: Sign up and create an API key at [Cheaper Inference]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: Defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: Defaults to `{default_model}`; see the [model list]({model_docs_url}) for all model IDs

Cheaper Inference is an OpenAI-compatible gateway to models from many labs. Each model costs 15–60% less than the list price of its lab.
Translation.Groq Model List Load Failed: Unable to load Groq model list right now. You can still enter a model name manually; it will be validated during generation.
Translation.Groq API Key Required for Model List: Add a Groq API key to load available models automatically.
Translation.Get Help: If you need help, or have any questions, you can join discord for help: https://harryai.cc
Translation.Please Select a Valid Video Source: Please Select a Valid Video Source
Translation.Wan 2.2 Local Help: Self-hosted Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B. Local generation is GPU-intensive and can take significant time and VRAM. Configure the official Wan checkout, checkpoint directory, and dedicated worker Python under `[wan22_local]` in `config.toml`. Model paths stay server-side and are never added to task payloads.
Translation.Wan 2.2 Ready: Wan 2.2 is ready for local generation.
Translation.LTX 2.5 Local Help: Self-hosted LTX 2.5. Local generation is GPU-intensive and runtime/memory use depends on the selected mode. Configure the official LTX-2 checkout, split model files, and dedicated worker Python under `[ltx25_local]` in `config.toml`. Model paths stay server-side and native model audio is removed before the existing MoneyPrinter audio pipeline.
Translation.LTX 2.5 Ready: LTX 2.5 is ready for local generation.
Translation.Local AI Generation Mode Help: Fast uses LTX 2.5 Distilled for quicker iteration and is normally the lighter option. Quality uses DFR refinement, requires the configured detailing LoRA, and may need more runtime and GPU memory. Actual requirements depend on your installed model/runtime and GPU.
Translation.Local AI Seed Help: Base seed for deterministic scene generation. Each later scene increments this seed.
Translation.Local AI Visual Style Help: Optional visual prompt guidance for the Scene Director, for example warm 35mm documentary, product macro photography, or clay stop-motion. MoneyPrinter still creates scene-specific prompts from the script and keeps narration accuracy plus no-text/logo constraints.
Translation.Local AI Multiple Videos Help: Local AI scenes are generated once per task and shared across all {count} final output variant(s). Increasing this value reruns composition; it does not multiply Wan/LTX scene inference unless you explicitly regenerate a scene.
Translation.Please Upload Local Materials First: Please upload at least one local material file first.
Translation.Unsupported Upload File Type: The uploaded file type is not supported.
Translation.Voice Example: This is an example text for testing speech synthesis
Translation.Estimated Voiceover Duration: Estimated full voiceover: about {min}–{max} sec (local estimate, no API call)
Translation.Voiceover Script Required: Add a video script to estimate and preview the full voiceover.
Translation.Full Voiceover Preview Cost Hint: A full preview calls the selected TTS service and may use API credits.
Translation.AI Video Material Coverage: {basis}. At {clip} sec per clip, about {needed} clips are recommended. The current {count} clip(s) cover approximately {coverage} sec, with a possible shortfall of {shortfall} sec. Actual coverage depends on the generated footage and editing settings; existing clips are looped if needed, without additional generation charges.
Translation.Voice Preview No Audio: The TTS service did not return preview audio. Check its settings and the application logs.
Translation.Voice Preview Busy: A video task is currently using the voice settings. Try again shortly.
Translation.Voice Preview Duration Unavailable: The preview audio was generated, but its duration could not be read. Check the application logs.
Translation.No voices available for the selected TTS: No voices available for the selected TTS server. Please select another server.
Translation.Fish Audio API Key: Fish Audio API Key ([Get API Key](https://fish.audio/app/developers))
Translation.VoxCPM Model ID Placeholder: Select a speech_synthesis model ID in ModelBest
Translation.VoxCPM Reference Audio Help: Upload a short reference clip to clone its voice for this VoxCPM request. Uploads are limited to 20 MiB and the converted WAV to 5 MiB.
Translation.VoxCPM Reference Audio Notice: This clip is sent to ModelBest for voice cloning. Only use your own voice or a voice you are authorized to use. It is kept only for this browser session and task.
Translation.VoxCPM Reference Audio Upload Too Large: Reference audio upload must not exceed {limit} MiB.
Translation.VoxCPM High Fidelity Delivery Help: In addition to cloning the voice, continue the example audio's pacing, emotion, and pronunciation using its exact transcript. The voice reference above is reused by default.
Translation.VoxCPM Separate Prompt Audio: Use a different pacing and emotion example
Translation.VoxCPM Separate Prompt Audio Help: By default, the voice reference above is also used as the delivery example. Enable this only to follow another clip's pacing and emotion; that clip may also slightly influence accent and timbre.
Translation.VoxCPM Prompt Audio Help: Upload an example whose pacing, emotion, and pronunciation should be continued. It does not replace the voice reference above that identifies the speaker. Maximum upload: 20 MiB; converted WAV: 5 MiB.
Translation.VoxCPM Prompt Text Help: Enter the exact words spoken in the current pacing and emotion example, not the new video script.
Translation.Transcribe VoxCPM Prompt Audio Help: Use the configured local Whisper model to transcribe the audio currently used as the pacing and emotion example. The model may be downloaded on first use if it is not cached.
Translation.VoxCPM Prompt Audio Transcribed: The example audio transcript was generated. Review it before synthesis.
Translation.VoxCPM Prompt Audio Transcription Failed: The example audio could not be transcribed. Check the Whisper configuration or enter the transcript manually.
Translation.VoxCPM Prompt Transcript Review: Review names, numbers, punctuation, and mixed-language terms before synthesis. The transcript is not sent until you request a preview or generation.
Translation.VoxCPM Prompt Audio Upload Too Large: Delivery prompt audio must not exceed {limit} MiB.
Translation.VoxCPM Prompt Text Required: Enter the exact transcript of the current pacing and emotion example.
Translation.VoxCPM Prompt Pair Required: The pacing and emotion example and its exact transcript must be provided together.
Translation.VoxCPM Prompt Invalid: Pacing and emotion continuation cannot be used: {error}
Translation.Kokoro Voices Placeholder: leave empty to list the server's voices, or e.g. af_heart, bf_emma, hf_alpha
Translation.tts_provider_tips.azure-tts-v2: Requires an Azure Speech **region** and **API key**. Create or view them in the [Azure Portal](https://portal.azure.com/#view/Microsoft_Azure_ProjectOxford/CognitiveServicesHub/~/SpeechServices).
Translation.tts_provider_tips.siliconflow: Requires a SiliconFlow API key from the [console](https://cloud.siliconflow.cn/account/ak). Numeric speed and volume gain are supported.
Translation.tts_provider_tips.gemini-tts: Requires a Gemini API key from [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey). [Preview all supported voices](https://aistudio.google.com/generate-speech) in Google's Voice Library. Pace and style are controlled through natural-language instructions.
Translation.tts_provider_tips.mimo-tts: Requires a Xiaomi MiMo API key; see the [first API call](https://mimo.mi.com/docs/quick-start/first-api-call). MiMo V2.5 controls pace and style through natural-language instructions.
Translation.tts_provider_tips.minimax-tts: Use a MiniMax TTS API key from the [China platform](https://platform.minimaxi.com/user-center/basic-information/interface-key) or [global platform](https://platform.minimax.io/user-center/basic-information/interface-key). The key and endpoint must belong to the same platform. If left empty, the MiniMax LLM key and its matching endpoint are reused.
Translation.tts_provider_tips.elevenlabs: Requires an [API key](https://elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys). Add voices to your favorites in the [Voice Library](https://elevenlabs.io/app/voice-library) first.
Translation.tts_provider_tips.chatterbox: Self-hosted. Run a compatible [Chatterbox TTS API](https://github.com/travisvn/chatterbox-tts-api), then enter a Base URL ending in `/v1`; the API key is usually optional.
Translation.tts_provider_tips.kokoro: Self-hosted and free: run a compatible [Kokoro-FastAPI](https://github.com/remsky/Kokoro-FastAPI) server (Apache-2.0 model, CPU is enough), then enter a Base URL ending in `/v1`; the voice list is read from the server.
Translation.tts_provider_tips.fish_audio: Requires a Fish Audio API key from the [developer portal](https://fish.audio/app/developers). [Browse public voices](https://fish.audio) or configure custom voices in `config.toml`. See [pricing & terms](https://fish.audio/pricing).
Translation.tts_provider_tips.voxcpm: Requires a [ModelBest API Key](https://platform.modelbest.cn/console/keys) and a model ID with the `speech_synthesis` capability. The API streams WAV audio and supports the default voice in this integration. Numeric speed is not supported; describe the desired pace at the start of the script, for example `(slightly faster)`. Optionally upload a reference clip to clone its voice; high-fidelity delivery can reuse that clip with its exact transcript or use a separate performance example.
Translation.Hide Basic Settings:
Hide Basic Settings

Hidden, the basic settings panel will not be displayed on the page.

If you need to display it again, please set `hide_config = false` in `config.toml`
Translation.Volcano Engine Ark API Key Help: Optional when a Volcano Engine Ark API Key is already configured under LLM Settings or through VOLCENGINE_ARK_API_KEY.
Translation.OpenAI Image API Key Help: Optional for local or compatible gateways that do not require authentication.
Translation.OpenAI Image Size Help: Leave empty to choose an OpenAI-compatible size automatically from the video aspect. Custom gateways may accept other sizes.
Translation.OpenAI Image Prompt Template Help: Use {term} where the script keyword should be inserted. Leave empty to send the original keyword.
Translation.Stock Video APIs Help: Search existing video clips from stock-footage providers.
Translation.AI Video Generation APIs Help: Generate new video clips from script keywords. Provider fees may apply.
Translation.AI Image Generation APIs Help: Generate images from script keywords and render them into video clips. Provider fees may apply.
Translation.OpenAI Image Configuration Example: Example: Base URL `https://api.openai.com/v1`, model `gpt-image-2`. Compatible services may use different addresses and model IDs; follow your provider's documentation.
Translation.Settings Preset Help: Export the current script, video, audio, and subtitle settings to a JSON file, or import a file to restore them. Uploaded materials, custom voiceover, and custom background music are not included.
Translation.Settings Preset Import Failed: This file is not a valid MoneyPrinterTurbo settings preset.
Translation.Key Backup Help: Export every API key saved in the settings to a JSON file, then import it to restore the keys on another machine or after a reinstall.
Translation.Key Backup Warning: The exported file stores your API keys as plain text. Keep it private and do not share it.
Translation.Key Restore Failed: This file is not a valid MoneyPrinterTurbo key backup.
Translation.Video Cache Management Help: Only automatically downloaded video materials are cleaned. Uploaded materials and generated videos are not affected. Do not clean the cache while generating a video.
Translation.Cache Cleanup Preview: This will clean {count} cache files and free approximately {size}.
Translation.Cache Cleanup Completed: Cache cleanup completed: deleted {count} files and freed {size}.
Translation.Cache Cleanup Completed With Failures: Cache cleanup partially completed: deleted {count} files and freed {size}; {failed} files could not be deleted.
Translation.Onboarding Model Settings Description: After the tour, open Settings to choose a provider, enter the API key, Base URL, and model name, and test the connection.
Translation.Onboarding Creation Settings Description: Enter a topic, then adjust the video, audio, and subtitle options as needed. Most defaults can be used as-is.
Translation.Onboarding Generate Video Description: Start generation after confirming the settings. Track progress and open results from Task Manager at the top.
Translation.Resume Task Help: Continue this failed local AI task using its saved narration, plan, and valid completed scenes.
Translation.Regenerate Task Confirmation: Load this task's script and generation settings? This will replace the current form values, but will not modify the original task or video.
Translation.Task Restore Failed: This task does not contain reusable generation settings.
Translation.Task Configuration Loaded: The historical task configuration has been loaded. Review it, then click Generate Video.
Translation.Task Restore Local Materials Warning: Local materials cannot be restored automatically. Please upload them again.
Translation.Task Restore Custom Audio Warning: Custom audio cannot be restored automatically. Please upload it again.
Translation.Runtime Configuration Busy: A video task is using the current service settings. Try again after it finishes.
Translation.WaveSpeed AI Video Help: Generate brand-new clips from your script keywords with WaveSpeed AI text-to-video models instead of searching stock footage. Generation is billed per clip by WaveSpeed.
Translation.WaveSpeed Billing Notice: Each generated clip is billed by WaveSpeed. Based on the estimated voiceover duration and the clip duration, roughly {min}-{max} clip(s) will be generated. Generation runs segment by segment and stops as soon as enough footage is collected.
Translation.WaveSpeed Billing Notice Without Script: Each generated clip is billed by WaveSpeed. Enter or generate the video script to see an estimated clip count. Generation runs segment by segment and stops as soon as enough footage is collected.
Translation.Confirm WaveSpeed Charge: I understand WaveSpeed video generation is a paid service
Translation.Confirm WaveSpeed Charge Help: Clips are generated on demand, one script segment at a time, and generation stops once the collected footage covers the voiceover duration. Fees are charged by WaveSpeed per generated clip.
Translation.Confirm WaveSpeed Charge Required: Please confirm the WaveSpeed video generation charge before generating the video.
Translation.Volcano Engine Seedance Help: Generate brand-new clips through the official Volcano Engine Ark Seedance API. Each submitted clip is a paid Ark task.
Translation.Volcano Engine Ark API Key: Volcano Engine Ark API Key ([Get API Key](https://console.volcengine.com/ark/region:ark+cn-beijing/apikey))
Translation.Please Enter the Volcano Engine Ark API: Please enter the **Volcano Engine Ark API Key**
Translation.Volcano Engine Seedance Billing Notice: Each generated clip is billed by Volcano Engine Ark. Based on the estimated voiceover duration and clip duration, roughly {min}-{max} paid task(s) will be submitted. Generation stops as soon as enough footage is collected.
Translation.Volcano Engine Seedance Billing Notice W: Each generated clip is billed by Volcano Engine Ark. Enter or generate the video script to see an estimated task count.
Translation.Confirm Volcano Engine Seedance Charge: I understand Volcano Engine Seedance generation creates paid Ark tasks
Translation.Confirm Volcano Engine Seedance Charge H: Seedance clips are submitted one at a time and stop once they cover the voiceover duration. Ark bills each submitted generation task.
Translation.Confirm Volcano Engine Seedance Charge R: Please confirm the Volcano Engine Seedance charge before generating the video.
Translation.Metaso MiniMax H3 Help: Generate brand-new clips from script keywords through Metaso's MiniMax H3 V2 proxy. Each clip creates a paid asynchronous task.
Translation.Metaso MiniMax API Key Help: Register through the MoneyPrinterTurbo referral link and enter the independent API key issued by Metaso. It cannot be shared with the MiniMax LLM API key.
Translation.Metaso MiniMax Resolution Help: MiniMax H3 supports 768P and 2K. This controls the generated source material; MPT still exports on its fixed output canvas (1920×1080 for 16:9). Metaso currently lists CNY 0.09/s for 768P and CNY 0.15/s for 2K; the checkout price is authoritative.
Translation.Metaso MiniMax Invalid Resolution: The configured Metaso MiniMax resolution `{value}` is invalid. Select one of: {supported}. The existing value has not been changed.
Translation.Please Enter the Metaso MiniMax API Key: Please enter the **Metaso MiniMax API Key**
Translation.Metaso MiniMax Billing Notice: Each generated clip is billed by Metaso. At {resolution}, the estimated voiceover and clip duration require roughly {min}-{max} paid task(s). Generation stops as soon as enough footage is collected.
Translation.Metaso MiniMax Billing Notice Uploaded A: Each generated clip is billed by Metaso. The current settings use {resolution}, {duration}-second clips, and {count} output video(s). With an uploaded voiceover, the paid task count is based on the audio file's actual duration, and generation stops as soon as enough footage is collected.
Translation.Metaso MiniMax Billing Notice Without Sc: Each MiniMax H3 clip is billed by Metaso. Enter or generate the video script to see an estimated task count.
Translation.Confirm Metaso MiniMax Charge: I understand Metaso MiniMax H3 creates paid video tasks
Translation.Confirm Metaso MiniMax Charge Help: Clips are submitted one script segment at a time and stop once they cover the voiceover duration. Metaso bills the submitted generation tasks.
Translation.Confirm Metaso MiniMax Charge Required: Please confirm the Metaso MiniMax H3 charge before generating the video.
Translation.Please Configure the OpenAI Image Source: Please configure the **Base URL** and **Model** for the OpenAI compatible image source (**API Key** optional for local gateways)
Translation.Video Encoder Help: Advanced option. Default follows the app's stable encoder policy, currently libx264. If a selected hardware encoder is unavailable, the app automatically falls back to libx264.
Translation.llm_provider_endpoint_selector_help.moon: Select the platform where your API Key was created. China and Global accounts use different API endpoints.
Translation.llm_provider_authentication_error.moonsh: Authentication failed. Make sure the API Key matches the selected Kimi platform. China uses platform.kimi.com with api.moonshot.cn; Global uses platform.kimi.ai with api.moonshot.ai. Current Base URL: {base_url}. Provider response: {error}
Translation.llm_provider_tips.ollama:
##### Ollama Configuration
- **API Key**: not required
- **Base Url**: usually `http://localhost:11434/v1` for local runs or `http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1` for Docker{docker_hint}
- **Model Name**: required; run `ollama list` and enter an installed model, such as `qwen:7b`
Translation.llm_provider_tips.claude_code:
##### Claude Code Configuration
- **API Key**: not required; the local `claude` CLI authenticates with your Claude subscription (Pro / Max / Team)
- **Base Url**: not required
- **Model Name**: optional; leave empty to use the CLI default, or set `claude-opus-5` / `claude-sonnet-5`
- **Claude CLI Path**: optional; leave empty to resolve `claude` from PATH
- Requires the CLI to be installed and logged in where MoneyPrinterTurbo runs. In Docker, pass a `claude setup-token` token as `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`
- Requests use your Claude subscription usage limits. Conflicting `ANTHROPIC_*` / `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_*` environment variables are stripped before the CLI runs, so an API key in the environment cannot silently bill your API account

Translation.Narration Draft Help: Maximum upload: 20 MiB. Without fitting, decoded duration must match within 2 ms. With fitting, recordings within 0.5x–2x tempo are adjusted to the range. Preview the saved recording before applying; restore active edits before modifying it.

Translation.Narration Text Help: Generate speech with the task’s saved voice, or upload a recording. Fitting keeps the video length fixed and changes speech tempo without changing pitch. Save transcript only updates the recording label/captions; generate speech again if the spoken words should change.
Translation.Keep Natural Narration Duration: Keep natural recording length and retime the timeline

Translation.Timeline Preview Required: Preview the revised timeline before applying. Draft, source or scene changes require a fresh preview.
